demo.text: Seeing a spike in failed payment webhooks. We retry forever and it's hammering the queue.

demo.author: Priya
demo.text: Could we cap it? Most go through on the 2nd try.

demo.text: Checked last week: 97% succeed by attempt 3.

demo.text: OK, let's go with 3 retries with backoff, then send to manual review.
